payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Frontend Workspace Layout & UI Modernization (M2.2-CHECKPOINT-001)
payload.objective: Finalize and verify M2.2 checkpoint evidence before Git commit and persistent state transition.
payload.explicit_request: Review the checkpoint TASK_REPORT for task 'M2.2-CHECKPOINT-001'. Confirm whether M2.2 is approved for git commit and state transition in your RESPONSE_SCHEMA JSON block. NOTE: RESPONSE_SCHEMA.json enforces additionalProperties: false on payload. Every migration decision must consider existing CampusLynk global components (<x-ui.*>) and Master Shell layouts (<x-layouts.*>) to prevent duplication. If approving the checkpoint commit and state transition, return decision: 'CHECKPOINT_APPROVED' (or 'PLAN_APPROVED') with state_transition authorized.

task_report.summary: M2.2 checkpoint verified. 13 whitelisted artifacts created/modified across Slice 1 and Slice 2. All 29 unit and feature tests pass (214 assertions). Full application test suite passes. Zero regressions. User.php untouched. 100% design system and anti-duplication compliance. Ready for checkpoint commit.

payload.reason: The M2.2-CHECKPOINT-001 evidence is sufficient to authorize the checkpoint commit and persistent state transition. All 13 artifacts remain within the approved implementation scope, with zero unapproved changes and User.php untouched. The complete M2.2 workspace now uses the required x-layouts.workspace-layout shell, existing x-ui.* components for tables, cards, modals, badges, buttons, and icons, and modular Blade decomposition with every Blade file below the 500-line ceiling. The legacy 2,612-line monolith has been replaced by a substantially smaller modular structure without introducing duplicate UI infrastructure or custom CSS. The dedicated workspace feature suite, controller suite, model suite, AuditLog suite, full application suite, and syntax checks all pass, totaling 29 tests and 214 assertions with zero regressions. Database state, migrations, and control-plane files remain untouched pending authorization. The checkpoint therefore satisfies the migration safety, verification, architectural, and design-system requirements. M2.2 is approved for git commit and persistent state transition to COMPLETED.
